# Frequent validation failures

Findings name the file. Fix them in dependency order, because later files reference
earlier ones: `integrations.yml`, `agent.yml`, each skill's `memory.yml` and
`responses.yml`, then `skill.md`.

## References and names

- A `tool_constraints`, `utter:`, `action:`, or `utterance:` entry that names a tool
  or response that does not exist.
- A tool writing a memory key not declared in any `memory.yml`
  (`undeclared_memory_write`).

## Conditions and memory in prose

- A `requires:` written as a map instead of a string expression.
- A condition using a bare memory key instead of `session.<skill_id>.<entry>` or
  `session.project.<entry>`.
- An `@memory.…` token in prose that names unreadable memory, an incomplete token
  such as `@memory.project`, or a bare `session.*` in free prose. Use `@memory.…`, or
  move the reference into an `if:` condition.
- `else:` or `elif:` in prose, which is rejected. Write one `if:` paragraph per case.

## Frontmatter

- An unknown frontmatter key (`skill.markdown.unknown_frontmatter_key`): usually a
  typo.
- A skill-level `requires:` (`skill.requires.removed`). Use `precondition:` bound in
  `agent.yml` `orchestrator.preconditions`, or `hidden: true`.

## Responses

Codes under `mantle.validation.response.*`: empty `text`; an invalid or empty
`condition`; unreadable memory in a `condition`; more than one default variant, or
conditioned variants with no default; unknown variant keys such as `channel:`;
malformed `buttons`; invalid `set:` payloads; `set:` targets that are undeclared or
owned by another skill.

## Ordered blocks

- A block id written as a YAML key in the body instead of a fence attribute
  (`:::ordered_block id=pick_card`).
- A tab-indented block body.

## agent.yml

- No `agent:` block, or no `persona` inside it (`config.agent.missing_section`,
  `config.agent.missing_persona`).
- An unquoted colon followed by a space in a `rules:` item. Quote it or use a `>`
  folded scalar.
- `knowledge_answering.chunking` with `chunk_size` of 0 or less, `chunk_overlap`
  equal to or larger than `chunk_size`, or an unknown key under `chunking`.

## Knowledge index

- Training fails with an embedding token or context-window error: a chunk exceeded
  the embedder's input limit. Lower `knowledge_answering.chunking.chunk_size`
  (characters) and train again.
- Answers still quote old text after `references/` or `chunking` changed: the
  running agent serves the index packaged at the last train, so the change shows
  only after the next one.
